verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own server-side support page and a NullEngine class, a headless engine variant that lets game code run without a GPU or canvas, for example under Node in CI. The pack only gives these page titles and URLs, with no content showing a test-runner or CI workflow. missing for 10: documented unit/integration testing guidance, CI setup examples, evidence that rendering paths are exercised headlessly, independent or hands-on corroboration.
